inputs.text: high-end 3D animated feature film still, stylized CG characters with appealing simplified shapes, soft subsurface skin, large expressive eyes, clean readable silhouettes, rich saturated but controlled palette, painterly global illumination, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition. Vertical film poster key art: on a Baghdad rooftop at dusk an old kite-maker (stylized 3D animated character, a man of about 70; thin build; face: kind deep-set eyes, white stubble; short white hair; dark brown eyes; weathered olive skin; wearing a patchwork waistcoat of large coloured squares over a grey ankle-length dishdasha (a loose robe reaching down to the ankles); brown leather sandals; red kite string wound on his right wrist) releases a red kite into the sky while a courier girl (a teenage girl of about 17; slim build; small pointed chin face; short black bob hair; amber eyes; fair skin; wearing a yellow rain jacket, navy shorts over black leggings, red sneakers; messenger bag strap across her left shoulder) looks up beside him; both in the same stylized 3D animated style; cinematic lighting, warm dusk sky, the city skyline below; the top quarter of the poster is open sky left empty for a title; the title text 'THE KITE MAKER' in large serif capitals across the top. Every frame stays stylized CG animation: no photographic realism, no live-action texture, no uncanny semi-real faces, no motion blur smears, no text artifacts, no extra fingers or limbs.
